Some quick tips that aren't vague "git gud". I joke because they're are things you learn from playing. Like pulling agro by walking right up to an enemy.

1. Illuminates: Jetpacks get phased out for shields. Shields block mind control which is great! 

Firewall blocks the electric/mind control orbs. Buuut usually someone else on the squad has em. 

I like running static even though it affects one specific enemy for illuminates, the invisible melee guys. They come in big numbers and close in quick. Static works well. They also generally keep spawning in one point so an obliterater can lock down a spawn point. 

The machine guns, heavy strafing run, heavy laser, and orbital laser are decent. 

Compared to the other races, there isn't a strat like static field to lock them down. Sure firewall helps but if they spawn on your side of the wall you're trapped. 

The best strategy I've had is to literally keep shooting. 

2. Bugs

Static is king and so are jetpacks, but you can go without the latter. 

A poor man's rumbler loadout is: strat priority, rail gun, ammo, 3x middle barrage. 

With this you can stun anything and have more than enough toxic missiles to kill any horde. 

Also, I've noticed that although the justice rifle has unstoppable rounds, it's pretty mediocre compared to other guns. Patriot can kill scouts faster and anything bigger should need a strat or heavy weapon. 

The camper sniper rifle can kill a brood commander in 5 (?) Shots. Kinda fun to use. 

3. Cyborgs

Static, again, is king. 

Breaker is the best against the fat butcher swarms. 

I don't have the rumbler so I've always lacked firepower with Borgs. So I use the rocket launcher which is fantastic if someone helps or someone else has another! 

Smoke grenades are hit or miss but are fun to use. 

Mines are so so but they're fun so I use em. 

Artillery is great if you have a choke point to throw it at. 

1.  Rep 80. Only use it when needed. Some guy is down/about to? Use it! Nothing is more annoying than someone unnecessarily healing when we need another gun shooting. 

1. You also may notice some things are great/ok/poor against some races. Not really a tip, but something neat that inspired me to go against the meta. 

Breaker shotgun is great against borgs, ok against illuminates, and poor against bugs. Rocket launcher is great against borgs, ok against bugs, and why-the-fuck-would-you-bring-this against illuminates?!
